ocsf#dhcp.label: OCSF 1.9 DHCP Activity
ocsf#dhcp.description: OCSF v1.9 DHCP Activity (4004), category 4 (Network Activity). ISC dhcpd / Infoblox DHCP / Windows DHCP lease logs. activity_id from the DHCP message type (1 Discover, 2 Offer, 3 Request, 4 Decline, 5 Ack, 6 Nak, 7 Release, 8 Inform, 9 Expire); type_uid = 4004*100 + activity_id. ocsf@windows_security.label: OCSF 1.9 Windows Event Log (multi-class dispatch)
ocsf@windows_security.description: OCSF v1.9, per-event class dispatch for Windows Security/Sysmon/PowerShell/System Event Log channels. One Windows channel's EventIDs span ~15 different OCSF classes (Authentication, Account Change, Group Management, Process, Network, DNS, File System, Registry, Windows Service, Scheduled Job, Event Log, Script, ...) -- class_uid/activity_id are computed PER EVENT by the extraction-stage dispatcher (ported from Simon's Windows_Events_to_OCSF pipeline, github.com/simondev65/cribl-splunk-windows-to-json) and read here as __ocsf_class_uid/__ocsf_activity_id; this mapping is a thin declarative rename of the dispatcher's flat __ocsf_* output into real nested OCSF attribute paths. category_uid/type_uid/metadata.version are NOT auto-grounded for golden canonicalMap specs (groundOcsfPipeline only runs for the AI-mapping tier) so they are set explicitly here, same as ocsf#authentication.
